record.original_question: Suppose one could prove that whenever two quadratic polynomials P_c1 and P_c2 are topologically conjugate, they are also quasiconformally conjugate. Would that implication force local connectivity of the quadratic connectedness locus, that is, the Mandelbrot set of parameters c for which the Julia set of P_c(z) = z^2 + c is connected?

evidence.quote: Question 11. If one could show that topological conjugacy of Pc1 and Pc2 implies that Pc1 is quasiconformally conjugate to Pc2 , would this imply local connectivity of the quadratic connectedness locus (ie., the Mandelbrot set, consisting of all c for which the Julia set of Pc is connected)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each complex parameter c ∈ ℂ, consider the quadratic polynomial P_c(z) = z^2 + c acting on ℂ. The filled Julia set K_c is the set of points whose forward orbit under P_c is bounded, and the Julia set J_c = ∂K_c. The Mandelbrot set M is the set of parameters c ∈ ℂ for which J_c is connected (equivalently, the orbit of 0 under P_c is bounded).

Two polynomials P_{c_1} and P_{c_2} are said to be topologically conjugate on ℂ if there is an orientation-preserving homeomorphism h: ℂ → ℂ such that h ∘ P_{c_1} = P_{c_2} ∘ h, and quasiconformally conjugate if such an h can be chosen to be a quasiconformal homeomorphism.

Suppose one knew the following implication:

(∗) For every pair c_1, c_2 ∈ ℂ, if P_{c_1} and P_{c_2} are topologically conjugate, then they are quasiconformally conjugate.

Question: Does the validity of (∗) imply that the Mandelbrot set M is locally connected?
artifact.status_search_result: Local connectivity of the Mandelbrot set (MLC) remains an open central conjecture in holomorphic dynamics as of 2026. While Yoccoz established MLC at all finitely renormalizable parameters and recent work (Dudko–Lyubich and others) has extended it to broad classes including Feigenbaum-type parameters, the general implication from topological-to-quasiconformal rigidity to MLC has not been established, and MLC itself is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: On the MLC Conjecture and the Renormalization Theory in Complex Dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: recent developments... with emphasis on the MLC conjecture, the problem of local connectivity of the Mandelbrot set
status_evidence.claim: MLC is still an active open conjecture being studied via renormalization theory.

status_evidence.title: A survey on MLC, Rigidity and related topics
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on MLC, rigidity, and related questions in holomorphic dynamics.
status_evidence.claim: The relationship between rigidity and MLC remains a central open theme.

status_evidence.title: MLC at Feigenbaum points
status_evidence.snippet: Proves MLC at Feigenbaum parameters via a priori bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on MLC at specific parameter classes; full MLC remains open.
